test_title: RRB NTPC (UG) CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 08 Sept, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
This question is based on the five, three-digit numbers given below.

(Left) 564 782 368 225 743 (Right)

(Example: 697 – First digit = 6, second digit = 9 and third digit = 7)

(NOTE: All operations to be done from left to right.)If 2 is added to the first digit of every number, in how many numbers will the first digit be exactly divisible by the second digit?
solution:
Given Series - (Left) 564 782 368 225 743 (Right)

2 is added to the first digit of every number

(Left) 764 982 568 __**425**__ 943 (Right)

First digit be exactly divisible by the second digit.

425.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 4"**
